text: Use when a section needs to respond to the visitor — tabs, an accordion, a carousel, a calculator, something that appears as the visitor scrolls.
This site's published pages run your section's React code in the visitor's browser. A section can keep state, respond to clicks and run effects.

**Stay on the brand.** Colours, type, corners, surfaces and motion come from the brand, as in writing-a-section. No eval or new Function, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no <script>, <iframe> or <form>, and no cookies.
note: Rules 1–2 (same drawing on server and browser; stay still while editing) are mechanics.
